title: Sloth with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#a8854f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#c9a86d'/>
  <!-- arms over branch -->
  <path d='M28 48 Q22 62 24 74' stroke='#a8854f' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 48 Q78 62 76 74' stroke='#a8854f' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 72 Q22 78 26 80' stroke='#8a6a3a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 72 Q78 78 74 80' stroke='#8a6a3a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#c9a86d'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f0dcb4'/>
  <!-- dark eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='33' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#7a5a34'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='33' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#7a5a34'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='33' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='40.8' cy='31.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='31.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43.4' cy='34.4' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.4' cy='34.4' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle accents around eyes -->
  <path d='M34 24 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <path d='M66 24 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a4228'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.8' cy='40' rx='1.3' ry='0.9' fill='#7a5a34'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 46 Q50 50 55 46' stroke='#5a4228' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
